resources.string:
Runs on the TV itself, no computer needed.

First turn on debugging: Settings → Device Preferences → About → press Build 7 times, then Developer options → USB debugging.

Cleaning turns off ads, telemetry and demo mode. Chromecast, voice search, mirroring and installed apps stay. Nothing is deleted, and "Put everything back" undoes it all.
Clean up and install the home screen
Connecting to the TV\'s debugging. If it asks \"Allow USB debugging?\", tick \"Always allow\" and press OK.
USB debugging is off (port 5555 is closed). Turn it on with the steps on the left and press the button again.
Debugging wasn\'t allowed. Press the button again and answer OK on the prompt.
This TV reports \"%1$s\", not Sony. This setup is for Sony only, so nothing was changed.
This TV\'s platform is %1$s, and the list was written for %2$s. Packages it doesn\'t have are skipped.
The Home button belongs to %1$s, which isn\'t a stock launcher this setup knows. Nothing was changed.
Disabled: %1$d. Not on this TV: %2$d. Failed: %3$d.
Trying the new home screen for 3 seconds…
The new home screen crashed when tried. The Home button wasn\'t touched and still opens the stock screen.
The new screen didn\'t take over Home (it went to %1$s), so the stock one is back.
Done. Press \"Open the new home screen\". Once everything works, turn USB debugging off: Settings → Device Preferences → Developer options. It\'s unencrypted, and nothing here needs it any more.
Done, everything is back. Press \"Open the new home screen\" to go to the stock screen. To remove this app: Settings → Apps.
The Home button still goes to %1$s. Restart the TV and try again.
